title: Castle Clash
tags: chess,strategy,2 player,robot,learn chess,puzzles,board game,sun and moon,owl
description: Real chess between the Sun Kingdom and the Moon Kingdom, with friendly pieces that blink and cheer. Play Wizard Hoot the owl robot at four levels, play a friend on one screen, learn every piece in short lessons, and solve 24 checkmate puzzles.
notes: Complete chess rules (castling, en passant, promotion picker, check, checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, fifty-move rule, insufficient material) with SAN move list; the move generator matches the standard perft counts (window.__brbTest.perft). The robot searches in short time slices with setTimeout (no Web Worker under the frame CSP) so the page never freezes. Saves settings, robot wins, lesson stars and solved puzzles in localStorage key 'castle-clash-v1' and the game in progress in 'castle-clash-game-v1' (both through the SDK storage shim). Leaderboard: BRB.score.submit(points, 'robot wins') with points = robot wins weighted Pawn 1, Knight 2, Bishop 4, Queen 8. Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 (packs dress, art-biomes-2, art-props, art-animals): the castle theme's world behind the game, the kit's title (with the player's own avatar), pause screen, icons, buttons and font; Wizard Hoot is the kit's owl in a wizard hat and the two-player animals are kit characters, shown as head-and-shoulders busts in round frames tinted gold (Sun Kingdom) or blue (Moon Kingdom) with a sun or moon badge. The game draws its own sun, moon and jigsaw-piece icons and the two-kingdom castles art (title badge, side panel on wide screens) in the kit's sticker style. After a robot win the results card waits 3 s so the site's New best note never covers its buttons. The board and pieces are the game's own canvas drawing.
